_doc: Hand-maintained risk classification: rules run IN ORDER, first regex match on the
control id (page/pane/kind:name) wins. Risk classes: safe (click/read freely),
quasi (GET with server side effect - needs restore protocol), mutating-live-allowed
operator-supervised only). Anything unmatched is UNCLASSIFIED and fails the crawl
spec - that failure is the review loop. DECLARED entries keep their hand-set risk;
rules apply to crawled controls only. Page-wide safe catch-alls at the END are
sound because the drift pin fails on ANY new id - a future mutating control still
forces manual review at the gate. Names/panes are digit-stripped lowercase.
